steps.title: Step 1 · Vocab Quest 1: match the new words (3 min)
steps.instructions: New words today (10): work placement /wɜːk ˈpleɪsmənt/ (n) · employer /ɪmˈplɔɪə/ (n) · employee /ɪmˈplɔɪiː/ (n) · applicant /ˈæplɪkənt/ (n) · contract /ˈkɒntrækt/ (n) · wage /weɪdʒ/ (n) · overtime /ˈəʊvətaɪm/ (n) · working hours /ˈwɜːkɪŋ ˈaʊəz/ (n) · part-time /ˌpɑːt ˈtaɪm/ (adj) · full-time /ˌfʊl ˈtaɪm/ (adj). Review words (6): timetable = thời khóa biểu · certificate = chứng chỉ · supervisor = người giám sát · participant = người tham gia · stabilise = ổn định lại · rank = xếp hạng, đứng thứ. Choose the correct meaning (A–J) for each new word.

items.explain: work placement = kỳ thực tập. Collocation: do a work placement. Example: He did a three-month work placement at a travel agency.
employer = nhà tuyển dụng. Collocation: a good employer. Example: My employer lets me choose my shifts.
employee = nhân viên. Collocation: a full-time employee. Example: The company has 200 employees.
applicant = ứng viên. Collocation: a successful applicant. Example: Each applicant must send a reference.
contract = hợp đồng. Collocation: sign a contract. Example: She signed a one-year contract.
wage = tiền công. Collocation: a low wage. Example: The wage is nine pounds an hour.
overtime = giờ làm thêm. Collocation: work overtime. Example: Staff get extra pay for overtime.
working hours = giờ làm việc. Collocation: flexible working hours. Example: The working hours are from nine to five.
part-time = bán thời gian. Collocation: a part-time job. Example: He has a part-time job at a bookshop.
full-time = toàn thời gian. Collocation: a full-time job. Example: She works full-time as a nurse.
